Extend your hips and knees explosively, rising onto your toes and shrugging your shoulders.
Land softly and reset before the next repetition.

name: Jump Squat
description: An explosive bodyweight squat ending with a jump, for leg power and conditioning.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down to about parallel, swinging your arms back.
Jump as high as you can, swinging your arms up.
Land softly with bent knees and go straight into the next squat.

name: Jumping Jack
description: A classic cardio warm-up of jumping the feet apart and together while raising and lowering the arms.
instructions: Stand with your feet together and arms by your sides.
Jump your feet apart while raising your arms overhead.
Jump back to the start position.
Keep a steady rhythm, landing softly on the balls of your feet.

name: Jumping Lunge
description: A plyometric lunge where the legs switch in the air, building leg power and conditioning.
instructions: Start in a lunge with one foot forward and both knees bent.
Jump explosively and switch your legs in the air.
Land softly in a lunge with the other foot forward.
Repeat continuously, keeping your torso upright.

name: Kipping Pull Up
description: A pull-up using a hip swing (kip) to generate momentum, common in CrossFit to do more repetitions.
instructions: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than your shoulders.
Swing between an arched position and a hollow position, driven by your hips.
At the end of the hollow swing, drive your hips up and pull your chin over the bar.
Push away from the bar to return into the swing; master strict pull-ups first.

name: Knee Raise Parallel Bars
description: A knee raise performed on parallel bars or a captain's chair, working the lower abs.
instructions: Support yourself on the parallel bars or captain's chair with your back against the pad.
Raise your knees toward your chest by curling your pelvis.
Lower your legs slowly without swinging.

name: Kneeling Pulldown (Band)
description: A pulldown performed kneeling, which removes the thigh pad and makes the core work to stay stable.
instructions: Anchor the band high and kneel in front of it, holding one end in each hand.
Kneel facing the anchor point with your torso upright.
Pull your elbows down toward your sides, bringing your hands to your upper chest.
Squeeze your lats, then return slowly to full extension.

name: Kneeling Pulldown (Cable)
description: A pulldown performed kneeling, which removes the thigh pad and makes the core work to stay stable.
instructions: Kneel in front of a high pulley with a bar or rope attachment.
Kneel facing the anchor point with your torso upright.
Pull your elbows down toward your sides, bringing your hands to your upper chest.
Squeeze your lats, then return slowly to full extension.

name: Kneeling Push Up
description: A push-up performed on the knees, an easier variation to build toward full push-ups.
instructions: Start on your knees with your hands slightly wider than your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to knees.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Push back up to straight arms.

name: L-Sit Hold
description: A static hold where the legs are held straight out in front with the body supported on the hands, working the abs, hip flexors and triceps.
instructions: Place your hands on parallel bars, parallettes or the floor next to your hips.
Press down to lift your body, arms straight and shoulders pushed down.
Raise your straight legs in front of you to hip height.
Hold for the planned time; bend your knees to make it easier.

name: Landmine 180
description: A rotational core exercise where the end of a landmine bar is swung from one hip to the other.
instructions: Stand facing the landmine with your feet wider than shoulder width.
Hold the end of the bar with both hands at arm's length in front of your chest.
Rotate your torso and pivot your feet to bring the bar down toward one hip.
Bring it back up over the top and down to the other side, under control.

name: Landmine Press
description: A shoulder press using a barbell anchored in a landmine, whose angled path is easy on the shoulders.
instructions: Hold the end of the landmine bar at shoulder height with one or both hands.
Stand in a staggered stance with your core braced.
Press the bar up and forward until your arm is extended.
Lower it back to your shoulder under control.

name: Landmine Row
description: A row with a barbell anchored in a landmine, holding the free end with a handle or both hands.
instructions: Straddle the bar and hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Hold the bar just below the plates with both hands or with a V-handle.
Row the bar toward your chest, driving your elbows back.
Lower under control to full extension.

name: Landmine Squat and Press
description: A combined exercise: a squat holding the end of a landmine bar, followed by a press as you stand up.
instructions: Hold the end of the landmine bar at chest height with both hands.
Squat down, keeping your chest up.
Drive up out of the squat and use the momentum to press the bar up and forward.
Lower the bar back to your chest as you go into the next squat.

name: Lat Pulldown (Band)
description: A vertical pull to the chest that develops the lats and upper back.
instructions: Anchor the band high, kneel or sit facing it and hold one end in each hand.
Pull the bar or handles down to your upper chest, driving your elbows toward your sides.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom without leaning far back.
Return slowly until your arms are fully extended.

name: Lat Pulldown (Cable)
description: A vertical pull to the chest that develops the lats and upper back.
instructions: Sit at the pulldown station with your thighs under the pads and grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Pull the bar or handles down to your upper chest, driving your elbows toward your sides.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom without leaning far back.
Return slowly until your arms are fully extended.

name: Lat Pulldown (Machine)
description: A vertical pull to the chest that develops the lats and upper back.
instructions: Adjust the thigh pad, sit down and grip the handles above you.
Pull the bar or handles down to your upper chest, driving your elbows toward your sides.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom without leaning far back.
Return slowly until your arms are fully extended.

name: Lat Pulldown (Plate Loaded)
description: A vertical pull to the chest that develops the lats and upper back.
instructions: Adjust the thigh pad, sit down and grip the handles above you.
Pull the bar or handles down to your upper chest, driving your elbows toward your sides.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom without leaning far back.
Return slowly until your arms are fully extended.

name: Lat Pulldown - Close Grip
description: A lat pulldown with a narrow grip, which increases the range of motion and the involvement of the lower lats.
instructions: Sit at the pulldown station and grip the bar with your hands about shoulder-width apart or closer.
Pull the bar to your upper chest, driving your elbows down.
Return slowly to full extension.

name: Lat Pulldown (Narrow V-Handle)
description: A lat pulldown with a V-handle and neutral grip, which lets you pull with a strong elbow position.
instructions: Attach a V-handle to the high pulley and sit with your thighs under the pads.
Pull the handle to your upper chest, leaning back slightly.
Return slowly to full extension.

name: Lat Pulldown (Reverse Grip)
description: A lat pulldown with an underhand grip, which involves more biceps and lower lats.
instructions: Grip the bar with your palms facing you, about shoulder-width apart.
Pull the bar to your upper chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Return slowly to full extension.

name: Lat Pullover (Dumbbell)
description: A movement where the arms travel in an arc from overhead to the hips, isolating the lats and stretching the chest.
instructions: Lie across or along a flat bench, holding one dumbbell with both hands above your chest.
Lower the weight in an arc behind your head with a slight bend in the elbows until you feel a stretch.
Pull it back over your chest using your lats.
Keep your elbows fixed and your ribs down.

name: Lat Pullover (Machine)
description: A movement where the arms travel in an arc from overhead to the hips, isolating the lats and stretching the chest.
instructions: Sit in the pullover machine with your elbows against the pads.
Lower the weight in an arc behind your head with a slight bend in the elbows until you feel a stretch.
Pull it back over your chest using your lats.
Keep your elbows fixed and your ribs down.

name: Lat Pullover (Plate Loaded)
description: A movement where the arms travel in an arc from overhead to the hips, isolating the lats and stretching the chest.
instructions: Sit in the plate-loaded pullover machine with your elbows against the pads.
Lower the weight in an arc behind your head with a slight bend in the elbows until you feel a stretch.
Pull it back over your chest using your lats.
Keep your elbows fixed and your ribs down.

name: Lat Pullover (Bar)
description: A standing cable pullover with a straight bar, also called a straight-arm pulldown, isolating the lats.
instructions: Stand facing a high pulley with a straight bar, arms extended and slightly bent.
Hinge slightly forward at the hips.
Pull the bar down in an arc to your thighs, keeping your arms straight.
Return slowly until your arms are overhead.

name: Lat Pullover (Rope)
description: A standing cable pullover with a rope, which allows a longer range at the bottom.
instructions: Stand facing a high pulley with a rope, arms extended in front of you.
Hinge slightly forward at the hips.
Pull the rope down in an arc to your hips, spreading the ends apart at the bottom.
Return slowly until your arms are overhead.

name: Lateral Box Jump
description: A sideways jump onto a box that develops lateral power and agility.
instructions: Stand side-on to a low box with your feet hip-width apart.
Dip into a quarter squat and jump sideways onto the box.
Land softly with both feet and bent knees.
Step down and repeat on the other side.

name: Lateral Leg Raises
description: A side-lying leg raise that strengthens the hip abductors.
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs straight and your head resting on your arm.
Raise your top leg as high as comfortable, keeping it straight and your toes pointing forward.
Lower slowly; complete all reps before switching sides.

name: Lateral Lunge
description: A side lunge that works the quads, glutes and adductors.
instructions: Stand with your feet together.
Take a wide step to the side and sit your hips back over that leg, keeping the other leg straight.
Push back to the start.
Alternate sides or complete all reps on one side first.

name: Lateral Raise
description: A shoulder raise to the sides that targets the side deltoids.
instructions: Stand on the middle of the band and hold one end in each hand at your sides.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height, elbows slightly bent.
Lower slowly without shrugging.

name: Lateral Raise (Seated, Dumbbell)
description: A seated lateral raise, which removes any leg drive and keeps the side deltoids under tension.
instructions: Sit on the end of a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height, elbows slightly bent.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

name: Lateral Raise (Seated, Machine)
description: A seated lateral raise, which removes any leg drive and keeps the side deltoids under tension.
instructions: Sit at the lateral raise machine with the pads against the outside of your arms.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height, elbows slightly bent.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.

name: Lateral Raise (Standing, Dumbbell)
description: A standing lateral raise that targets the side deltoids.
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height, elbows slightly bent.
Lead with your elbows and avoid shrugging, then lower slowly.

name: Lateral Raise (Standing, Machine)
description: A standing lateral raise that targets the side deltoids.
instructions: Stand at the lateral raise machine with the pads against the outside of your arms.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height, elbows slightly bent.
Lead with your elbows and avoid shrugging, then lower slowly.

name: Lateral Squat
description: A side-to-side squat (also called a cossack-style squat) that works the legs and hip mobility.
instructions: Stand with your feet wide apart, toes slightly out.
Shift your weight to one side and squat down over that leg, keeping the other leg straight.
Push back to the centre and repeat on the other side.

name: Leg Press (Machine)
description: A machine press with the legs that works the quads and glutes with the back supported.
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back flat and your feet shoulder-width apart on the platform.
Release the safety and lower the platform until your knees are bent to about 90 degrees.
Push the platform back up without locking your knees.

name: Leg Press (Plate Loaded)
description: A machine press with the legs that works the quads and glutes with the back supported.
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back flat and your feet shoulder-width apart on the platform.
Release the safety and lower the platform until your knees are bent to about 90 degrees.
Push the platform back up without locking your knees.

name: Leg Press Horizontal (Machine)
description: A seated horizontal leg press where you push the platform straight ahead.
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad and your feet on the platform.
Push the platform away until your legs are almost straight.
Return slowly until your knees are bent to about 90 degrees.

name: Leg Press Horizontal (Plate Loaded)
description: A seated horizontal leg press where you push the platform straight ahead.
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad and your feet on the platform.
Push the platform away until your legs are almost straight.
Return slowly until your knees are bent to about 90 degrees.

name: Leg Raise Parallel Bars
description: A straight-leg raise on parallel bars or a captain's chair, working the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Support yourself on the parallel bars or captain's chair with your back against the pad.
Raise your straight legs in front of you to hip height or higher.
Lower slowly without swinging.

name: Leg Raise Parallel Bars (Weighted)
description: A leg raise on parallel bars or a captain's chair with ankle weights or a dumbbell between the feet.
instructions: Attach ankle weights or hold a light dumbbell between your feet.
Support yourself on the parallel bars or captain's chair.
Raise your legs in front of you to hip height.
Lower slowly without swinging.

name: Low Row (Suspension)
description: A row performed with suspension straps, with difficulty set by the body angle.
instructions: Hold the handles and lean back with your arms straight and your body in a straight line.
Pull your chest toward the handles, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly back to straight arms.

name: Lunge (Barbell)
description: A forward step into a split stance that works the quads, glutes and balance.
instructions: Place a barbell on your upper back and stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Step forward and lower your back knee toward the floor until both knees are bent to about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee in line with your toes.
Push through the front heel to return to the start, then alternate legs.

name: Lunge (Dumbbell)
description: A forward step into a split stance that works the quads, glutes and balance.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step forward and lower your back knee toward the floor until both knees are bent to about 90 degrees.
Keep your torso upright and your front knee in line with your toes.
Push through the front heel to return to the start, then alternate legs.

name: Lying Bicep Curl
description: A curl lying face up on a flat bench with the arms hanging below, which stretches the biceps strongly.
instructions: Lie on a high flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging toward the floor.
Curl the dumbbells up without moving your upper arms.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.

name: Lying Knee Raise
description: A lying core exercise where the bent knees are brought toward the chest, working the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands by your sides or under your glutes.
Raise your knees toward your chest, lifting your hips slightly off the floor.
Lower slowly until your feet almost touch the floor.

name: Lying Leg Raise
description: A lying straight-leg raise that works the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs straight and hands under your glutes.
Raise your straight legs until they are vertical.
Lower slowly, stopping before your lower back arches.

name: Lying Neck Curls
description: A neck flexion exercise lying on the back with the head hanging off a bench.
instructions: Lie on your back on a bench with your head and neck off the end.
Lower your head slowly backward.
Bring your chin toward your chest, then lower again; move slowly and avoid any jerking.

name: Lying Neck Curls (Weighted)
description: A lying neck flexion with a light plate on the forehead, protected by a towel.
instructions: Lie on your back on a bench with your head off the end.
Hold a light plate on your forehead, with a folded towel underneath.
Lower your head slowly backward, then curl your chin toward your chest.
Use a light weight and move slowly.

name: Lying Neck Extension
description: A neck extension exercise lying face down with the head off a bench.
instructions: Lie face down on a bench with your head and neck off the end.
Lower your head slowly toward the floor.
Raise your head back up until it is in line with your body; move slowly.

name: Lying Neck Extension (Weighted)
description: A lying neck extension with a light plate on the back of the head, protected by a towel.
instructions: Lie face down on a bench with your head off the end.
Hold a light plate on the back of your head, with a folded towel underneath.
Lower your head slowly, then raise it until it is in line with your body.
Use a light weight and move slowly.

name: Meadows Rows
description: A single-arm landmine row with an overhand grip on the end of the bar, popularised by John Meadows, for the lats and upper back.
instructions: Stand perpendicular to the landmine bar in a staggered stance, front knee bent.
Hinge forward and grip the end of the bar overhand with the hand furthest from the anchor.
Row the bar up, driving your elbow high and back.
Lower under control to a full stretch.

name: Moutain Climber
description: A dynamic plank where the knees are driven toward the chest quickly, for cardio and core endurance.
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Drive one knee toward your chest, then switch legs quickly.
Keep your hips low and your back flat.
Continue at a fast pace for the planned time.

name: Muscle Up
description: An advanced bodyweight movement combining a pull-up and a dip to get from below to above a bar or rings.
instructions: Hang from a bar or rings with a false grip if using rings.
Pull explosively, bringing the bar toward your lower chest.
Lean forward over the bar and transition your elbows above it.
Press out to straight arms, then lower back under control.

name: Negative Pull Up
description: A pull-up where only the lowering phase is performed slowly, a progression toward full pull-ups.
instructions: Use a box or a jump to get your chin over the bar.
Hold the top position briefly.
Lower yourself as slowly as possible (3 to 5 seconds) to a full hang.
Step back up and repeat.

name: Nordic Hamstrings Curls
description: An eccentric hamstring exercise where the body is lowered forward from the knees, very effective for strength and injury prevention.
instructions: Kneel on a pad with your ankles secured under a bar or held by a partner.
Keep your body straight from knees to head.
Lower yourself forward as slowly as possible using your hamstrings.
Catch yourself with your hands and push back up; pull with your hamstrings as you get stronger.

name: Oblique Crunch
description: A crunch to the side that targets the obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and dropped to one side.
Place your hands lightly beside your head.
Curl your shoulders up toward your hips, contracting the side of your waist.
Lower slowly; complete all reps before switching sides.

name: Overhead Bicep Curl
description: A cable curl with the arms raised to the sides at shoulder height, as in a double-biceps pose.
instructions: Stand between two high pulleys, holding one handle in each hand with your arms out to the sides.
Curl the handles toward your head, keeping your upper arms level.
Return slowly to straight arms.

name: Overhead Lunge
description: A lunge with a weight held overhead, which adds shoulder stability and core demand.
instructions: Press a dumbbell (or two) overhead and lock your arm.
Step forward into a lunge, keeping the weight stable overhead.
Push back to the start and alternate legs.

name: Overhead Press (Barbell)
description: A standing press of the weight from the shoulders to overhead, working the deltoids and triceps.
instructions: Hold a barbell at your collarbones with a grip slightly wider than your shoulders.
Stand with your feet hip-width apart, glutes and core braced.
Press the weight straight up until your arms are extended overhead.
Lower back to shoulder level under control without arching your lower back.

name: Overhead Press (Cable)
description: A standing press of the weight from the shoulders to overhead, working the deltoids and triceps.
instructions: Stand between two low pulleys holding the handles at shoulder height.
Stand with your feet hip-width apart, glutes and core braced.
Press the weight straight up until your arms are extended overhead.
Lower back to shoulder level under control without arching your lower back.

name: Overhead Press (Dumbbell)
description: A standing press of the weight from the shoulders to overhead, working the deltoids and triceps.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Stand with your feet hip-width apart, glutes and core braced.
Press the weight straight up until your arms are extended overhead.
Lower back to shoulder level under control without arching your lower back.

name: Overhead Press (Kettlebell)
description: A standing press of the weight from the shoulders to overhead, working the deltoids and triceps.
instructions: Clean the kettlebells to the rack position at your shoulders.
Stand with your feet hip-width apart, glutes and core braced.
Press the weight straight up until your arms are extended overhead.
Lower back to shoulder level under control without arching your lower back.

name: Overhead Press (Smith Machine)
description: A standing press of the weight from the shoulders to overhead, working the deltoids and triceps.
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, glutes and core braced.
Press the weight straight up until your arms are extended overhead.
Lower back to shoulder level under control without arching your lower back.

name: Overhead Squat
description: A squat with the barbell held overhead with a wide grip, demanding mobility, stability and core strength.
instructions: Hold a barbell overhead with a wide snatch grip and locked arms.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
Squat down while keeping the bar over your mid-foot.
Stand back up without letting the bar drift forward.

name: Overhead Tricep Extension (EZ Bar)
description: An overhead triceps extension with an EZ bar, which stretches the long head of the triceps.
instructions: Hold an EZ bar overhead with your hands close together on the angled grips.
Lower the bar behind your head by bending your elbows, keeping them pointing up.
Extend your arms back to the top.

name: Overhead Tricep Extension (Seated, Barbell)
description: A seated overhead triceps extension, which stabilises the torso and isolates the triceps.
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support, holding a barbell or EZ bar overhead with a narrow grip.
Lower the weight behind your head by bending your elbows, keeping them pointing up.
Extend your arms back to the top.

name: Overhead Tricep Extension (Seated, Dumbbell)
description: A seated overhead triceps extension, which stabilises the torso and isolates the triceps.
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support, holding one dumbbell overhead with both hands.
Lower the weight behind your head by bending your elbows, keeping them pointing up.
Extend your arms back to the top.

name: Overhead Tricep Extension (Standing, Barbell)
description: A standing overhead triceps extension with free weights.
instructions: Stand holding a barbell or EZ bar overhead with a narrow grip.
Lower the weight behind your head by bending your elbows, keeping them pointing up.
Extend your arms back to the top without arching your back.

name: Overhead Tricep Extension (Standing, Dumbbell)
description: A standing overhead triceps extension with free weights.
instructions: Stand holding one dumbbell overhead with both hands.
Lower the weight behind your head by bending your elbows, keeping them pointing up.
Extend your arms back to the top without arching your back.

name: Overhead Tricep Extension (Staight Bar)
description: A cable overhead triceps extension with a straight bar, facing away from the machine.
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a pulley, grab it and turn away from the machine with the bar behind your head.
Step forward into a staggered stance, elbows pointing forward.
Extend your arms forward and up until they are straight.
Return slowly to a stretch behind your head.

name: Overhead Tricep Extension (V Grip)
description: A cable overhead triceps extension with a V-handle, facing away from the machine.
instructions: Attach a V-handle to a pulley, grab it and turn away from the machine with the handle behind your head.
Step forward into a staggered stance, elbows pointing forward.
Extend your arms until they are straight, then return slowly.

name: Palloff Press
description: An anti-rotation core exercise where a cable handle is pressed out in front of the chest while resisting the pull to the side.
instructions: Set a pulley at chest height and stand side-on to the machine.
Hold the handle with both hands against your chest and step away until there is tension.
Press the handle straight out in front of you without letting your torso rotate.
Hold briefly, bring it back to your chest, then switch sides after the set.

name: Palms Up Wrist Curl (Barbell)
description: A wrist curl with the palms facing up, working the forearm flexors.
instructions: Sit with your forearms resting on your thighs or a bench, wrists hanging over the edge, palms up.
Let the weight roll down toward your fingers.
Curl it back up by flexing your wrists, keeping your forearms still.

name: Palms Up Wrist Curl (Dumbbell)
description: A wrist curl with the palms facing up, working the forearm flexors.
instructions: Sit with your forearms resting on your thighs or a bench, wrists hanging over the edge, palms up.
Let the weight roll down toward your fingers.
Curl it back up by flexing your wrists, keeping your forearms still.

name: Pause Squat
description: A squat with a pause of a few seconds at the bottom, which builds strength out of the hole and control.
instructions: Place the bar on your upper back and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down to your normal depth.
Pause for 2 to 3 seconds at the bottom, staying tight.
Drive back up without bouncing.

name: Pendlay Row
description: A strict barbell row from the floor with the torso parallel to the ground, each rep starting from a dead stop.
instructions: Stand with the bar over your mid-foot and hinge until your torso is about parallel to the floor.
Grip the bar slightly wider than your shoulders.
Row the bar explosively to your lower chest.
Lower it back to the floor and reset before the next rep.

name: Pendulum Squat
description: A machine squat on a pendulum arc that keeps the torso upright and focuses on the quads.
instructions: Stand on the platform with your shoulders under the pads and your back against the pad.
Release the safety.
Squat down as deep as you can control, letting the machine guide the arc.
Push back up through your whole foot.

name: Pike Pushup
description: A push-up in an inverted V position that shifts the work to the shoulders, a step toward handstand push-ups.
instructions: Start in a downward dog position with your hips high and arms straight.
Bend your elbows to lower the top of your head toward the floor between your hands.
Push back up to straight arms.
Raise your feet on a box to make it harder.

name: Pilates
description: A low-impact method of controlled movements that builds core strength, posture and flexibility.
instructions: Start with breathing and gentle mobility to activate your deep core muscles.
Perform each movement slowly, focusing on control and alignment.
Keep your core engaged and your breathing steady throughout.
Finish with stretching.

name: Pinwheel Curl
description: A hammer curl across the body toward the opposite shoulder, emphasising the brachialis.
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing your body.
Curl one dumbbell across your body toward the opposite shoulder, keeping the neutral grip.
Lower slowly and alternate arms.

name: Pistol Squat
description: A single-leg squat to full depth with the other leg extended in front, demanding strength, balance and mobility.
instructions: Stand on one leg with the other leg extended in front of you.
Reach your arms forward for balance.
Squat down on the standing leg as low as possible, keeping the heel on the floor.
Stand back up without touching the floor with the extended leg.

name: Plank
description: A static core exercise where the body is held straight on the forearms and toes.
instructions: Place your forearms on the floor, elbows under your shoulders.
Extend your legs behind you, resting on your toes.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to heels, squeezing your glutes and abs.
Hold for the planned time without letting your hips sag.

name: Plank Pushup
description: A plank that moves between the forearms and the hands, working the core, shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Start in a forearm plank.
Place one hand and then the other on the floor to push up into a high plank.
Lower back down onto one forearm and then the other.
Alternate the leading arm and keep your hips still.

name: Plate Curl
description: A biceps curl holding a weight plate with both hands.
instructions: Stand holding a weight plate by its sides with both hands, arms extended.
Curl the plate up toward your chest, keeping your elbows at your sides.
Lower slowly to full extension.

name: Plate Press
description: A chest press holding a weight plate squeezed between the palms, which strongly contracts the inner chest.
instructions: Stand or lie down holding a plate squeezed between your palms against your chest.
Press the plate straight out in front of you while squeezing it hard.
Bring it back to your chest under control.

name: Power Clean
description: An Olympic lift where the bar is pulled explosively from the floor and caught on the front of the shoulders, developing power.
instructions: Set up as for a deadlift with a grip just outside your knees, back flat.
Lift the bar to your knees, then extend your hips and knees explosively.
Shrug and pull yourself under the bar, catching it on your shoulders in a quarter squat with your elbows high.
Stand up, then lower the bar under control; learn the technique with a coach.

name: Power Snatch
description: An Olympic lift where the bar is pulled from the floor to overhead in one explosive movement and caught in a partial squat.
instructions: Set up with a wide snatch grip, back flat and the bar over your mid-foot.
Lift the bar past your knees, then extend your hips explosively.
Pull yourself under the bar and catch it overhead with locked arms in a quarter squat.
Stand up and lower the bar under control; learn the technique with a coach.

name: Preacher Curl (Barbell)
description: A curl with the upper arms supported on a preacher bench, which isolates the biceps and prevents cheating.
instructions: Sit at the preacher bench with your armpits against the top of the pad and hold a barbell with an underhand grip.
Curl the weight up without lifting your arms off the pad.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight, without fully relaxing.

name: Preacher Curl (Dumbbell)
description: A curl with the upper arms supported on a preacher bench, which isolates the biceps and prevents cheating.
instructions: Sit or stand at the preacher bench with the back of one arm on the pad, holding a dumbbell.
Curl the weight up without lifting your arms off the pad.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight, without fully relaxing.

name: Preacher Curl (Machine)
description: A curl with the upper arms supported on a preacher bench, which isolates the biceps and prevents cheating.
instructions: Sit at the preacher curl machine with your arms on the pad and grip the handles.
Curl the weight up without lifting your arms off the pad.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight, without fully relaxing.

name: Preacher Curl (Plate Loaded)
description: A curl with the upper arms supported on a preacher bench, which isolates the biceps and prevents cheating.
instructions: Sit at the plate-loaded preacher curl machine with your arms on the pad and grip the handles.
Curl the weight up without lifting your arms off the pad.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight, without fully relaxing.

name: Preacher Curl (EZ Bar)
description: A preacher curl with an EZ bar, whose angled grip is easier on the wrists.
instructions: Sit at the preacher bench with your armpits against the top of the pad.
Hold an EZ bar on the angled grips with your palms up.
Curl the bar up without lifting your arms off the pad.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.

name: Press Under
description: An Olympic lifting drill where you press yourself down under a bar held overhead into a squat, for snatch and jerk stability.
instructions: Hold a light barbell on your back or overhead with a snatch grip.
Push against the bar to drive yourself down into a full squat while your arms lock out.
Hold the bottom position with the bar stable over your mid-foot.
Stand up and reset; use light weights only.

name: Pull Through
description: A cable hip hinge where a rope is pulled through the legs, working the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and stand facing away from the machine with the rope between your legs.
Walk forward until there is tension and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hinge at the hips, letting the rope travel back between your legs.
Drive your hips forward to stand up, squeezing your glutes.

name: Pull Up
description: A vertical bodyweight pull with an overhand grip that develops the lats and upper back.
instructions: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than your shoulders.
Pull your shoulder blades down, then pull your chest toward the bar.
Go up until your chin clears the bar.
Lower slowly to a full hang.

name: Pull Up (Assisted, Band)
description: A pull-up with assistance from a band or a counterweight machine, to build toward bodyweight pull-ups.
instructions: Loop a band over the bar and place your knee or foot in it.
Grip the bar or handles with an overhand grip slightly wider than your shoulders.
Pull until your chin clears the bar.
Lower slowly to full extension.

name: Pull Up (Assisted, Machine)
description: A pull-up with assistance from a band or a counterweight machine, to build toward bodyweight pull-ups.
instructions: Select the assistance weight and kneel or stand on the platform.
Grip the bar or handles with an overhand grip slightly wider than your shoulders.
Pull until your chin clears the bar.
Lower slowly to full extension.

name: Pull Up (Weighted)
description: A pull-up with extra weight attached to a belt or held between the legs.
instructions: Attach a weight to a dip belt (or hold a dumbbell between your feet).
Hang from the bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than your shoulders.
Pull until your chin clears the bar, then lower slowly to a full hang.

name: Pullaparts
description: A band pull-apart that strengthens the rear deltoids and upper back and improves posture.
instructions: Hold a band in front of you at shoulder height with straight arms, hands shoulder-width apart.
Pull the band apart by moving your hands out to the sides, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Return slowly under control.

name: Push Press
description: An overhead press driven by a quick dip and leg drive, letting you move heavier loads than a strict press.
instructions: Hold a barbell on the front of your shoulders with a grip slightly wider than your shoulders.
Dip by bending your knees slightly, keeping your torso upright.
Drive up explosively with your legs and press the bar overhead to locked arms.
Lower the bar back to your shoulders under control.

name: Push Up
description: The classic bodyweight push for the chest, shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Place your hands on the floor slightly wider than your shoulders.
Extend your legs behind you with your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the floor, elbows at about 45 degrees from your body.
Push back up to straight arms.

name: Push Up - Close Grip
description: A push-up with the hands closer than shoulder width, shifting more work to the triceps.
instructions: Place your hands on the floor a little narrower than your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line and your elbows close to your sides.
Lower your chest toward your hands.
Push back up to straight arms.

name: Push Up - One Arm
description: An advanced push-up on a single arm, demanding chest, triceps and core strength.
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your feet wide and one hand under your chest.
Place your other hand behind your back.
Lower your chest toward the floor without rotating your hips.
Push back up; progress from an incline if needed.

name: Push Up (Weighted)
description: A push-up with extra load from a weight vest or a plate on the back.
instructions: Put on a weight vest or have a partner place a plate on your upper back.
Place your hands slightly wider than your shoulders, body in a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Push back up to straight arms.

name: Quad Leg Extension (Machine)
description: A machine knee extension that isolates the quadriceps.
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad and the roller on the front of your ankles.
Extend your legs until they are straight.
Squeeze your quads at the top, then lower slowly.

name: Quad Leg Extension (Plate Loaded)
description: A machine knee extension that isolates the quadriceps.
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad and the roller on the front of your ankles.
Extend your legs until they are straight.
Squeeze your quads at the top, then lower slowly.

name: Rack Pull
description: A partial deadlift from pins or blocks set around knee height, which overloads the top of the lift and the upper back.
instructions: Set the safety pins or blocks so the bar sits just below or at knee height.
Grip the bar just outside your legs with a flat back.
Drive your hips forward to stand up with the bar.
Lower it back onto the pins under control.

name: Rear Delt Reverse Fly (Cable)
description: A reverse fly that isolates the rear deltoids and upper back.
instructions: Stand between two pulleys set at shoulder height and cross the cables, holding the left handle in your right hand and vice versa.
With a slight bend in your elbows, open your arms out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the end of the movement.
Return slowly to the start.

name: Rear Delt Reverse Fly (Dumbbell)
description: A reverse fly that isolates the rear deltoids and upper back.
instructions: With a slight bend in your elbows, open your arms out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the end of the movement.
Return slowly to the start.

name: Rear Delt Reverse Fly (Machine)
description: A reverse fly that isolates the rear deltoids and upper back.
instructions: Sit facing the pec deck machine with the handles set for the reverse fly.
With a slight bend in your elbows, open your arms out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the end of the movement.
Return slowly to the start.

name: Rear Delt Reverse Fly (Plate Loaded)
description: A reverse fly that isolates the rear deltoids and upper back.
instructions: Sit facing the plate-loaded reverse fly machine and grip the handles.
With a slight bend in your elbows, open your arms out to the sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades at the end of the movement.
Return slowly to the start.

name: Renegade Row
description: A plank combined with an alternating dumbbell row, working the back, core and shoulders.
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands on two dumbbells and feet wide.
Row one dumbbell to your hip while pressing the other into the floor.
Lower it and repeat on the other side.
Keep your hips square to the floor throughout.

name: Reverse Crunch (Cable)
description: A crunch where the pelvis curls toward the chest, working the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet attached to a low pulley by ankle straps.
Curl your pelvis and bring your knees toward your chest, lifting your hips off the floor.
Lower slowly until your feet almost touch the floor.

name: Reverse Crunch (Bodyweight)
description: A crunch where the pelvis curls toward the chest, working the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent at 90 degrees and your hands by your sides.
Curl your pelvis and bring your knees toward your chest, lifting your hips off the floor.
Lower slowly until your feet almost touch the floor.

name: Reverse Curl (Band)
description: A curl with an overhand grip that works the brachioradialis and forearm extensors as well as the biceps.
instructions: Stand on the band and hold one end in each hand with your palms facing down.
Hold the weight with your palms facing down, elbows at your sides.
Curl the weight up without moving your upper arms.
Lower slowly to full extension.

name: Reverse Curl (Barbell)
description: A curl with an overhand grip that works the brachioradialis and forearm extensors as well as the biceps.
instructions: Hold a barbell with an overhand grip at shoulder width.
Hold the weight with your palms facing down, elbows at your sides.
Curl the weight up without moving your upper arms.
Lower slowly to full extension.

name: Reverse Curl (Cable)
description: A curl with an overhand grip that works the brachioradialis and forearm extensors as well as the biceps.
instructions: Hold a straight bar attached to a low pulley with an overhand grip.
Hold the weight with your palms facing down, elbows at your sides.
Curl the weight up without moving your upper arms.
Lower slowly to full extension.

name: Reverse Curl (Dumbbell)
description: A curl with an overhand grip that works the brachioradialis and forearm extensors as well as the biceps.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing down.
Hold the weight with your palms facing down, elbows at your sides.
Curl the weight up without moving your upper arms.
Lower slowly to full extension.

name: Reverse Curl (Kettlebell)
description: A curl with an overhand grip that works the brachioradialis and forearm extensors as well as the biceps.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in each hand with your palms facing down.
Hold the weight with your palms facing down, elbows at your sides.
Curl the weight up without moving your upper arms.
Lower slowly to full extension.

name: Reverse Curl (Machine)
description: A curl with an overhand grip that works the brachioradialis and forearm extensors as well as the biceps.
instructions: Sit at the curl machine and grip the handles with your palms facing down.
Hold the weight with your palms facing down, elbows at your sides.
Curl the weight up without moving your upper arms.
Lower slowly to full extension.

name: Reverse Curl (Plate Loaded)
description: A curl with an overhand grip that works the brachioradialis and forearm extensors as well as the biceps.
instructions: Sit at the plate-loaded curl machine and grip the handles with your palms facing down.
Hold the weight with your palms facing down, elbows at your sides.
Curl the weight up without moving your upper arms.
Lower slowly to full extension.

name: Reverse Curl (EZ Bar)
description: A reverse curl with an EZ bar, whose angled grip reduces wrist strain.
instructions: Hold the EZ bar with an overhand grip on the angled parts.
Curl the bar up while keeping your elbows at your sides.
Lower slowly to full extension.

name: Reverse Curl (EZ Bar, Cable)
description: A reverse curl with an EZ bar, whose angled grip reduces wrist strain.
instructions: Attach an EZ bar to a low pulley.
Hold the EZ bar with an overhand grip on the angled parts.
Curl the bar up while keeping your elbows at your sides.
Lower slowly to full extension.

name: Reverse Curl (Seated Incline)
description: A reverse curl lying back on an incline bench, which stretches the forearms and biceps.
instructions: Lie back on a bench inclined to about 45 degrees, a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing back.
Curl the dumbbells up with an overhand grip.
Lower slowly to a full stretch.

name: Reverse Curl (Seated)
description: A seated reverse curl with dumbbells.
instructions: Sit on the end of a bench holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing down.
Curl the dumbbells up without moving your upper arms.
Lower slowly to full extension.

name: Reverse Curl (Standing)
description: A standing reverse curl with a barbell.
instructions: Stand holding a barbell with an overhand grip at shoulder width.
Curl the bar up without swinging, elbows at your sides.
Lower slowly to full extension.

name: Reverse Curl (Straight Bar)
description: A cable reverse curl with a straight bar.
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and hold it with an overhand grip.
Curl the bar up while keeping your elbows at your sides.
Lower slowly to full extension.

name: Reverse Grip Concentration Curl
description: A seated concentration curl with an overhand grip, for the brachioradialis and biceps.
instructions: Sit with your legs apart and rest the back of your upper arm against the inside of your thigh.
Hold the dumbbell with your palm facing down.
Curl it up without moving your upper arm.
Lower slowly to full extension.

name: Reverse Hyperextension (Plate Loaded)
description: A movement where the legs are raised behind the body while the torso is supported, strengthening the glutes, hamstrings and lower back.
instructions: Lie face down on the bench with your hips at the edge and your legs hanging down.
Attach the strap of the reverse hyper machine around your ankles.
Grip the handles to hold your torso in place.
Raise your legs behind you until they are in line with your body, squeezing your glutes.
Lower slowly under control.

name: Reverse Hyperextension (Bodyweight)
description: A movement where the legs are raised behind the body while the torso is supported, strengthening the glutes, hamstrings and lower back.
instructions: Lie face down on the bench with your hips at the edge and your legs hanging down.
Grip the handles to hold your torso in place.
Raise your legs behind you until they are in line with your body, squeezing your glutes.
Lower slowly under control.

name: Reverse Lunge (Barbell)
description: A lunge stepping backward, which is easier on the knees than a forward lunge.
instructions: Place a barbell on your upper back before stepping back.
Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step back with one leg and lower until both knees are bent to about 90 degrees.
Push through your front heel to return to standing.
Alternate legs or complete all reps on one side first.

name: Reverse Lunge (Bodyweight)
description: A lunge stepping backward, which is easier on the knees than a forward lunge.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Step back with one leg and lower until both knees are bent to about 90 degrees.
Push through your front heel to return to standing.
Alternate legs or complete all reps on one side first.

name: Reverse Plank
description: A plank facing the ceiling, supported on the hands and heels, which works the glutes, hamstrings and back.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs extended and hands behind your hips, fingers toward your feet.
Press into your hands and heels to lift your hips until your body is straight.
Squeeze your glutes and hold for the planned time.

name: Ring Dips
description: A dip on gymnastic rings, which adds a strong stability challenge to the chest, shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Support yourself on the rings with straight arms, rings close to your body.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your shoulders are slightly below your elbows.
Press back up and turn the rings out slightly at the top.
Keep the rings from drifting away from your body.

name: Romanian Deadlift (Barbell)
description: A hip hinge with slightly bent knees, lowering the weight to mid-shin, that targets the hamstrings and glutes.
instructions: Hold a barbell with an overhand grip just outside your thighs.
Stand tall holding the weight in front of your thighs.
Push your hips back with a slight bend in your knees, sliding the weight down your legs.
Lower until you feel a strong stretch in your hamstrings, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand back up.

name: Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell)
description: A hip hinge with slightly bent knees, lowering the weight to mid-shin, that targets the hamstrings and glutes.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Stand tall holding the weight in front of your thighs.
Push your hips back with a slight bend in your knees, sliding the weight down your legs.
Lower until you feel a strong stretch in your hamstrings, keeping your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand back up.

name: Row
description: A single-arm dumbbell row supported on a bench, for the lats and mid back.
instructions: Place one knee and one hand on a bench, with your back flat.
Hold a dumbbell in the other hand with your arm hanging straight down.
Row the dumbbell toward your hip, driving your elbow back.
Lower slowly to a full stretch; switch sides after the set.

name: Rowing Machine
description: Indoor rowing, a full-body cardio exercise that mainly uses the legs, back and arms.
instructions: Strap your feet in and grab the handle with straight arms.
Push with your legs first, then lean back slightly, then pull the handle to your lower ribs.
Return in reverse order: arms, then torso, then legs.
Keep a smooth rhythm, with the recovery about twice as long as the drive.

name: Running
description: Outdoor running, a cardio activity that develops endurance and works the legs.
instructions: Warm up with a few minutes of brisk walking or easy jogging.
Run with a relaxed upper body, short strides and your feet landing under your hips.
Keep a pace that matches the session goal (easy, tempo or intervals).
Cool down by walking for a few minutes.

name: Russian Twist
description: A seated rotation exercise with the torso leaning back, working the obliques.
instructions: Sit with your knees bent and lean back until your torso is at about 45 degrees.
Lift your feet off the floor if you can.
Rotate your torso from side to side, touching the floor next to your hips.
Keep your back straight and move with control.

name: Russian Twist (Weighted)
description: A Russian twist holding a weight plate, dumbbell or medicine ball.
instructions: Sit with your knees bent and lean back to about 45 degrees, holding a weight at your chest.
Lift your feet off the floor if you can.
Rotate your torso to bring the weight beside one hip, then the other.
Keep your back straight and move with control.

name: Scapular Pull Ups
description: A short-range movement hanging from a bar where only the shoulder blades move, building shoulder stability for pull-ups.
instructions: Hang from a bar with straight arms and an overhand grip.
Without bending your elbows, pull your shoulder blades down and back to lift your body slightly.
Hold briefly, then relax back into a full hang under control.

name: Seated Row - Bar Grip
description: A seated cable row with a straight bar, for the mid back and lats.
instructions: Sit at the cable row station with your feet on the platform and knees slightly bent.
Hold the bar with an overhand grip, arms extended and back straight.
Pull the bar to your lower ribs, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Return slowly to full extension without rounding your back.

name: Seated Row - V Handle
description: A seated cable row with a V-handle (neutral grip), for the mid back and lats.
instructions: Sit at the cable row station with your feet on the platform and knees slightly bent.
Hold the V-handle with your arms extended and back straight.
Pull the handle to your stomach, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Return slowly to full extension.

name: Shoulder Press (Barbell)
description: A seated press of the weight overhead, working the deltoids and triceps with the back supported.
instructions: Sit on a bench or machine with back support and your feet flat.
Hold a barbell at shoulder level with a grip slightly wider than your shoulders.
Press the weight up until your arms are extended overhead.
Lower back to shoulder level under control.

name: Shoulder Press (Dumbbell)
description: A seated press of the weight overhead, working the deltoids and triceps with the back supported.
instructions: Sit on a bench or machine with back support and your feet flat.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Press the weight up until your arms are extended overhead.
Lower back to shoulder level under control.

name: Shoulder Press (Kettlebell)
description: A seated press of the weight overhead, working the deltoids and triceps with the back supported.
instructions: Sit on a bench or machine with back support and your feet flat.
Press the weight up until your arms are extended overhead.
Lower back to shoulder level under control.

name: Shoulder Press (Machine)
description: A seated press of the weight overhead, working the deltoids and triceps with the back supported.
instructions: Sit on a bench or machine with back support and your feet flat.
Grip the handles, the seat set so that they start at shoulder height.
Press the weight up until your arms are extended overhead.
Lower back to shoulder level under control.

name: Shoulder Press (Plate Loaded)
description: A seated press of the weight overhead, working the deltoids and triceps with the back supported.
instructions: Sit on a bench or machine with back support and your feet flat.
Grip the handles, the seat set so that they start at shoulder height.
Press the weight up until your arms are extended overhead.
Lower back to shoulder level under control.

name: Shoulder Taps
description: A high plank where each hand taps the opposite shoulder, training anti-rotation core stability.
instructions: Start in a high plank with your feet slightly wider than hip-width.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder.
Put it back down and repeat with the other hand.
Keep your hips as still as possible.

name: Shrug (Barbell)
description: A shoulder elevation exercise that targets the upper traps.
instructions: Hold a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip.
Stand tall with your arms straight.
Raise your shoulders toward your ears as high as possible.
Hold briefly at the top, then lower slowly without rolling your shoulders.

name: Shrug (Cable)
description: A shoulder elevation exercise that targets the upper traps.
instructions: Hold a bar attached to a low pulley in front of your thighs.
Stand tall with your arms straight.
Raise your shoulders toward your ears as high as possible.
Hold briefly at the top, then lower slowly without rolling your shoulders.

name: Shrug (Dumbbell)
description: A shoulder elevation exercise that targets the upper traps.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Stand tall with your arms straight.
Raise your shoulders toward your ears as high as possible.
Hold briefly at the top, then lower slowly without rolling your shoulders.

name: Shrug (Machine)
description: A shoulder elevation exercise that targets the upper traps.
instructions: Position yourself in the shrug machine and grip the handles.
Stand tall with your arms straight.
Raise your shoulders toward your ears as high as possible.
Hold briefly at the top, then lower slowly without rolling your shoulders.

name: Shrug (Plate Loaded)
description: A shoulder elevation exercise that targets the upper traps.
instructions: Position yourself in the plate-loaded shrug machine and grip the handles.
Stand tall with your arms straight.
Raise your shoulders toward your ears as high as possible.
Hold briefly at the top, then lower slowly without rolling your shoulders.

name: Shrug (Smith Machine)
description: A shoulder elevation exercise that targets the upper traps.
instructions: Hold the Smith machine bar in front of your thighs and unhook it.
Stand tall with your arms straight.
Raise your shoulders toward your ears as high as possible.
Hold briefly at the top, then lower slowly without rolling your shoulders.

name: Side Bend (Dumbbell)
description: A lateral flexion of the torso that works the obliques.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand at your side; switch sides after the set.
Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Bend sideways at the waist as far as comfortable, without leaning forward or back.
Return to upright by contracting the opposite side of your waist.

name: Side Bend (Bodyweight)
description: A lateral flexion of the torso that works the obliques.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Bend sideways at the waist as far as comfortable, without leaning forward or back.
Return to upright by contracting the opposite side of your waist.

name: Side Plank
description: A plank on one forearm and the side of the foot, working the obliques and hip stabilisers.
instructions: Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder and legs stacked.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from head to feet.
Hold for the planned time, then switch sides.

name: Sissy Squat (Weighted)
description: A squat where the knees travel far forward and the torso leans back, isolating the quads, here with extra weight.
instructions: Hold a support with one hand and a plate against your chest with the other.
Rise onto your toes and lean back while bending your knees forward.
Lower as far as you can control, keeping a straight line from knees to shoulders.
Return to standing by extending your knees.

name: Sit Up
description: A full sit-up from lying to seated, working the abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet anchored or flat.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Sit up all the way until your torso is upright.
Lower back down slowly.

name: Sit Up (Weighted)
description: A sit-up holding a weight against the chest or overhead.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet anchored.
Hold a weight plate or dumbbell against your chest.
Sit up all the way, then lower back down slowly.

name: SkiErg
description: A cardio machine that reproduces cross-country ski poling, working the back, arms, core and legs.
instructions: Stand facing the machine with your feet hip-width apart and grab the handles above your head.
Pull the handles down by hinging at the hips and bending your knees slightly.
Finish with your hands by your thighs, then rise back up to the start.
Keep a smooth, rhythmic pace.

name: Skullcrusher (EZ Bar)
description: A lying triceps extension with an EZ bar, lowered toward the forehead.
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding an EZ bar above your chest with a narrow grip.
Lower the bar toward your forehead by bending only your elbows.
Extend your arms back to the start.

name: Skullcrusher (Barbell)
description: A lying triceps extension where the weight is lowered toward the head.
instructions: Hold a barbell with a narrow overhand grip.
Lie on a flat bench with your arms extended above your chest.
Lower the weight toward your forehead (or beside your head) by bending only your elbows.
Extend your arms back to the start, keeping your upper arms still.

name: Skullcrusher (Dumbbell)
description: A lying triceps extension where the weight is lowered toward the head.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing each other.
Lie on a flat bench with your arms extended above your chest.
Lower the weight toward your forehead (or beside your head) by bending only your elbows.
Extend your arms back to the start, keeping your upper arms still.

name: Sled Pull
description: Pulling a weighted sled with a rope or harness, which builds leg drive, back and grip strength.
instructions: Attach a rope or harness to the loaded sled.
Walk backward or forward with short, powerful steps, keeping your back flat.
Keep the tension constant for the planned distance.

name: Sled Push
description: Pushing a weighted sled across the floor, building leg power and conditioning with little impact.
instructions: Grip the sled handles with your arms extended and lean in with your body at about 45 degrees.
Drive the sled forward with short, powerful steps on the balls of your feet.
Keep your back flat and your core braced for the planned distance.

name: Spider Curl (Band)
description: A curl lying face down on an incline bench with the arms hanging vertically, which keeps tension on the biceps at the top.
instructions: Anchor the band under the bench and hold one end in each hand.
Lie face down on a bench inclined to about 45 degrees, arms hanging straight down.
Curl the weight up without moving your upper arms.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly.

name: Spider Curl (Barbell)
description: A curl lying face down on an incline bench with the arms hanging vertically, which keeps tension on the biceps at the top.
instructions: Hold a barbell with an underhand grip.
Lie face down on a bench inclined to about 45 degrees, arms hanging straight down.
Curl the weight up without moving your upper arms.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly.

name: Spider Curl (Dumbbell)
description: A curl lying face down on an incline bench with the arms hanging vertically, which keeps tension on the biceps at the top.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing forward.
Lie face down on a bench inclined to about 45 degrees, arms hanging straight down.
Curl the weight up without moving your upper arms.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly.

name: Spider Curl (Kettlebell)
description: A curl lying face down on an incline bench with the arms hanging vertically, which keeps tension on the biceps at the top.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell in each hand.
Lie face down on a bench inclined to about 45 degrees, arms hanging straight down.
Curl the weight up without moving your upper arms.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly.

name: Spider Curl (EZ Bar)
description: A spider curl with an EZ bar, lying face down on an incline bench or on the vertical side of a preacher bench.
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench, holding an EZ bar with an underhand grip, arms hanging straight down.
Curl the bar up without moving your upper arms.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly.

name: Split Jerk
description: An Olympic lift where the bar is driven from the shoulders to overhead while the legs split forward and back.
instructions: Hold the bar on the front of your shoulders with a clean grip.
Dip by bending your knees slightly, then drive the bar up explosively.
Split your feet forward and back as you push yourself under the bar, arms locked.
Bring your feet together under the bar, then lower it under control; learn the technique with a coach.

name: Split Squat
description: A static lunge where both feet stay in place, working the quads and glutes one leg at a time.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and take a long step forward into a split stance.
Lower your back knee toward the floor, keeping your torso upright.
Push through your front foot to rise, keeping your feet in place.
Complete all reps before switching legs.

name: Sprints
description: Short maximal-effort runs that develop speed, power and anaerobic conditioning.
instructions: Warm up thoroughly with easy running and dynamic drills.
Sprint at full effort for the planned distance (for example 20 to 100 metres).
Walk back or rest until you are recovered before the next sprint.
Stop when your speed drops noticeably.

name: Squat (Band)
description: The fundamental lower-body exercise that works the quads, glutes and adductors.
instructions: Stand on the middle of the band and hold the ends at your shoulders.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
Brace your core, then sit your hips back and down, keeping your chest up.
Lower until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor, knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up.

name: Squat (Barbell)
description: The fundamental lower-body exercise that works the quads, glutes and adductors.
instructions: Place the barbell on your upper back in a rack, unrack it and step back.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
Brace your core, then sit your hips back and down, keeping your chest up.
Lower until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor, knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up.

name: Squat (Dumbbell)
description: The fundamental lower-body exercise that works the quads, glutes and adductors.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides or at your shoulders.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
Brace your core, then sit your hips back and down, keeping your chest up.
Lower until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor, knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up.

name: Squat (Machine)
description: The fundamental lower-body exercise that works the quads, glutes and adductors.
instructions: Position yourself under the shoulder pads of the squat machine and release the safety.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
Brace your core, then sit your hips back and down, keeping your chest up.
Lower until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor, knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up.

name: Squat (Plate Loaded)
description: The fundamental lower-body exercise that works the quads, glutes and adductors.
instructions: Position yourself under the shoulder pads of the plate-loaded squat machine and release the safety.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
Brace your core, then sit your hips back and down, keeping your chest up.
Lower until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor, knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up.

name: Squat (Smith Machine)
description: The fundamental lower-body exercise that works the quads, glutes and adductors.
instructions: Place the Smith machine bar on your upper back, step your feet slightly forward and unhook the bar.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
Brace your core, then sit your hips back and down, keeping your chest up.
Lower until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor, knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up.

name: Squat (Bodyweight)
description: The fundamental lower-body exercise that works the quads, glutes and adductors.
instructions: Extend your arms in front of you for balance.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out.
Brace your core, then sit your hips back and down, keeping your chest up.
Lower until your thighs are at least parallel to the floor, knees tracking over your toes.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up.

name: Squat Row
description: A combined exercise where a cable row is performed from the bottom of a squat while standing up, working the legs and back.
instructions: Stand facing a pulley set at chest height, holding the handle with straight arms.
Squat down while keeping your arms extended.
Stand up and row the handle to your chest in one smooth movement.
Extend your arms as you squat back down.

name: Squeeze Press
description: A dumbbell bench press with the dumbbells pressed hard together throughout the movement, for chest contraction.
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding two dumbbells pressed together above your chest, palms facing each other.
Lower them to your chest while squeezing them together.
Press back up, keeping the dumbbells in contact.

name: StairMaster
description: A stair climbing machine, a cardio exercise that strongly works the glutes and quads.
instructions: Step onto the machine and set a comfortable speed.
Climb with your whole foot on each step, standing tall.
Use the rails only lightly for balance rather than leaning on them.
Increase the speed for intervals, then cool down at an easy pace.

name: Standing Military Press
description: A strict standing barbell press from the shoulders to overhead, with no leg drive.
instructions: Hold the barbell at your collarbones with a grip slightly wider than your shoulders.
Stand with your feet hip-width apart, glutes and abs tight.
Press the bar straight up, moving your head back slightly to let it pass.
Lower it back to your collarbones under control.

name: Step Up
description: Stepping onto a box or bench one leg at a time, working the quads, glutes and balance.
instructions: Stand facing a box or bench.
Place one foot fully on the box.
Drive through that heel to step up, bringing the other foot up.
Step back down under control and alternate legs.

name: Straight Leg Deadlift
description: A deadlift with nearly straight legs that strongly stretches and works the hamstrings.
instructions: Stand holding a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip.
Keep your legs almost straight and hinge at the hips, lowering the bar along your legs.
Lower until you feel a strong hamstring stretch, keeping your back flat.
Return to standing by driving your hips forward.

name: Stretching
description: A session of static or dynamic stretches to improve flexibility and help recovery.
instructions: Warm up gently before deep stretching.
Stretch each major muscle group, moving slowly into the position.
Hold each static stretch for 20 to 60 seconds while breathing calmly.
Never stretch to the point of pain.

name: Sumo Squat (Barbell)
description: A wide-stance squat with the toes turned out, which emphasises the adductors and glutes.
instructions: Place a barbell on your upper back.
Stand with your feet wider than shoulder width and your toes pointed out.
Squat down, pushing your knees out over your toes and keeping your chest up.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.

name: Sumo Squat (Dumbbell)
description: A wide-stance squat with the toes turned out, which emphasises the adductors and glutes.
instructions: Hold one dumbbell by the head with both hands between your legs.
Stand with your feet wider than shoulder width and your toes pointed out.
Squat down, pushing your knees out over your toes and keeping your chest up.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.

name: Sumo Squat (Kettlebell)
description: A wide-stance squat with the toes turned out, which emphasises the adductors and glutes.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell by the handle with both hands between your legs.
Stand with your feet wider than shoulder width and your toes pointed out.
Squat down, pushing your knees out over your toes and keeping your chest up.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.

name: Sumo Squat (Bodyweight)
description: A wide-stance squat with the toes turned out, which emphasises the adductors and glutes.
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder width and your toes pointed out.
Squat down, pushing your knees out over your toes and keeping your chest up.
Drive through your heels to stand back up.

name: Superman
description: A face-down exercise where the arms and legs are lifted off the floor, strengthening the lower back and glutes.
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended in front of you and legs straight.
Lift your arms, chest and legs off the floor at the same time.
Hold briefly, keeping your neck in line with your spine.
Lower slowly back down.

name: Swimming
description: Swimming, a full-body, low-impact cardio activity.
instructions: Warm up with a few easy lengths.
Keep a long, streamlined body position and steady breathing.
Alternate strokes or intervals according to your session.
Finish with a few easy lengths to cool down.

name: Swing
description: A kettlebell swing driven by the hips, which builds glute and hamstring power and conditioning.
instructions: Stand with your feet slightly wider than shoulder width and the kettlebell in front of you.
Hinge and hike the kettlebell back between your legs.
Drive your hips forward explosively to swing the kettlebell to chest height, arms straight.
Let it swing back between your legs and repeat, keeping your back flat.

name: T Bar Row
description: A row with a barbell anchored at one end, pulling a handle toward the chest, for the mid back and lats.
instructions: Straddle the bar and hinge at the hips with a flat back.
Grip the handle (or the bar just below the plates) with both hands.
Row the weight toward your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly to full extension.

name: Toe Touch
description: A crunch where the hands reach up toward the raised feet, working the upper abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs raised straight toward the ceiling.
Reach your hands toward your toes by lifting your shoulders off the floor.
Lower slowly and repeat.

name: Toes to Bar
description: A hanging exercise where the feet are brought up to touch the bar, working the whole core and grip.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip.
Engage your lats and swing slightly or stay strict.
Raise your feet until they touch the bar between your hands.
Lower under control and repeat.

name: Torso Rotation
description: A standing or seated torso twist that mobilises the spine and works the obliques.
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and your arms crossed or extended in front of you.
Rotate your torso to one side while keeping your hips facing forward.
Return to the centre and rotate to the other side.
Move slowly and stay within a comfortable range.

name: Treadmill - Running
description: Running on a treadmill, a cardio exercise with controlled speed and incline.
instructions: Step onto the treadmill and start at a walking speed.
Increase to your running pace progressively.
Run tall with relaxed arms and land under your hips, without holding the rails.
Slow down to a walk to cool down before stopping.

name: Treadmill - Walking
description: Walking on a treadmill, possibly on an incline, a low-intensity cardio exercise.
instructions: Step onto the treadmill and start at a slow pace.
Set a brisk walking speed and the incline you want.
Walk tall with a natural arm swing, without holding the rails.
Slow down progressively before stopping.

name: Triceps Dip (Assited)
description: A triceps dip on an assisted machine, where a counterweight reduces the load.
instructions: Select the assistance weight, kneel or stand on the platform and grip the handles.
Keep your torso upright and your elbows pointing back.
Lower until your elbows are bent to about 90 degrees.
Press back up to straight arms.

name: Triceps Dip
description: A dip on parallel bars with an upright torso, emphasising the triceps.
instructions: Support yourself on parallel bars with straight arms.
Keep your torso upright and your elbows close to your body.
Lower until your elbows are bent to about 90 degrees.
Press back up to straight arms.

name: Triceps Dip (Weighted)
description: A triceps dip with extra weight from a dip belt.
instructions: Attach a weight to a dip belt and support yourself on parallel bars.
Keep your torso upright and your elbows close to your body.
Lower until your elbows are bent to about 90 degrees.
Press back up to straight arms.

name: Triceps Extension
description: A machine triceps extension that isolates the triceps.
instructions: Sit at the machine with your upper arms on the pad and grip the handles.
Extend your elbows until your arms are straight.
Return slowly without letting the weight touch down.

name: Triceps Kickback (Cable)
description: A triceps extension behind the body with the torso hinged forward, isolating the triceps.
instructions: Hold a single handle attached to a low pulley.
Hinge forward with a flat back, upper arm parallel to the floor and elbow bent to 90 degrees.
Extend your elbow until your arm is straight behind you.
Squeeze, then return slowly without moving your upper arm.

name: Triceps Kickback (Dumbbell)
description: A triceps extension behind the body with the torso hinged forward, isolating the triceps.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand, the other hand and knee resting on a bench.
Hinge forward with a flat back, upper arm parallel to the floor and elbow bent to 90 degrees.
Extend your elbow until your arm is straight behind you.
Squeeze, then return slowly without moving your upper arm.

name: Triceps Pushdown (EZ Bar)
description: A cable triceps pushdown with an EZ bar.
instructions: Attach an EZ bar to a high pulley and hold it with an overhand grip.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Push the bar down until your arms are straight.
Return slowly until your forearms are about parallel to the floor.

name: Triceps Pushdown (Rope)
description: A cable triceps pushdown with a rope, spreading the ends apart at the bottom.
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and hold it with your palms facing each other.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Push down and spread the rope ends apart until your arms are straight.
Return slowly.

name: Triceps Pushdown (Straight Bar)
description: A cable triceps pushdown with a straight bar.
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley and hold it with an overhand grip.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Push the bar down until your arms are straight.
Return slowly.

name: Triceps Pushdown (V Bar)
description: A cable triceps pushdown with a V-bar.
instructions: Attach a V-bar to a high pulley and grip it.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Push the bar down until your arms are straight.
Return slowly.

name: Turkish Get Up
description: A movement from lying to standing while holding a kettlebell overhead, training shoulder stability, mobility and the whole body.
instructions: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell straight up in one hand, the knee on that side bent.
