Roll onto the opposite elbow, then the hand, keeping your eyes on the kettlebell.
Lift your hips, sweep your straight leg under you into a kneeling position, then stand up.
Reverse the steps to return to the floor; complete all reps before switching sides.

name: Upright Row (Barbell)
description: A vertical pull of the weight up the front of the body to chest height, working the side deltoids and traps.
instructions: Hold a barbell with an overhand grip, hands about shoulder-width apart.
Stand tall with your arms extended in front of you.
Pull the weight up along your body to chest height, leading with your elbows.
Lower slowly; stop before your hands go higher than your shoulders if it hurts.

name: Upright Row (Cable)
description: A vertical pull of the weight up the front of the body to chest height, working the side deltoids and traps.
instructions: Hold a bar attached to a low pulley with an overhand grip.
Stand tall with your arms extended in front of you.
Pull the weight up along your body to chest height, leading with your elbows.
Lower slowly; stop before your hands go higher than your shoulders if it hurts.

name: Upright Row (Dumbbell)
description: A vertical pull of the weight up the front of the body to chest height, working the side deltoids and traps.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Stand tall with your arms extended in front of you.
Pull the weight up along your body to chest height, leading with your elbows.
Lower slowly; stop before your hands go higher than your shoulders if it hurts.

name: Upright Row (Smith Machine)
description: A vertical pull of the weight up the front of the body to chest height, working the side deltoids and traps.
instructions: Hold the Smith machine bar in front of your thighs and unhook it.
Stand tall with your arms extended in front of you.
Pull the weight up along your body to chest height, leading with your elbows.
Lower slowly; stop before your hands go higher than your shoulders if it hurts.

name: V Up
description: A core exercise where the arms and legs are raised at the same time to touch, forming a V shape.
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms extended overhead and legs straight.
Raise your legs and torso at the same time, reaching your hands toward your feet.
Lower slowly back to the start without letting your feet touch the floor if you can.

name: Walking
description: Walking outdoors, a low-intensity cardio activity good for health and active recovery.
instructions: Walk tall with a natural arm swing.
Keep a brisk pace that raises your breathing slightly.
Wear comfortable shoes and adapt the distance to your goal.

name: Walking Lunge (Dumbbell)
description: Lunges performed while moving forward, alternating legs, for the quads, glutes and balance.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step forward into a lunge until both knees are bent to about 90 degrees.
Push through your front foot and bring your back leg forward into the next lunge.
Keep your torso upright and continue for the planned distance or reps.

name: Walking Lunge (Bodyweight)
description: Lunges performed while moving forward, alternating legs, for the quads, glutes and balance.
instructions: Step forward into a lunge until both knees are bent to about 90 degrees.
Push through your front foot and bring your back leg forward into the next lunge.
Keep your torso upright and continue for the planned distance or reps.

name: Wall Ball
description: A full-body exercise combining a squat and a throw of a medicine ball to a target on a wall.
instructions: Stand facing a wall holding a medicine ball at your chest.
Squat down below parallel, keeping your chest up.
Drive up explosively and throw the ball to the target on the wall.
Catch the ball and go straight into the next squat.

name: Wall Sit
description: A static squat with the back against a wall and thighs parallel to the floor, which builds quad endurance.
instructions: Stand with your back against a wall.
Slide down until your knees are bent to 90 degrees and your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Keep your back flat against the wall and your knees over your ankles.
Hold for the planned time.

name: Warm Up
description: A general warm-up that raises body temperature and prepares the joints and muscles for the session.
instructions: Do 5 minutes of light cardio (bike, rower, brisk walk).
Mobilise the main joints with dynamic movements (arm circles, hip circles, leg swings).
Do a few light sets of the first exercise of your session.

name: Wide Pull Up
description: A pull-up with a grip much wider than the shoulders, emphasising the upper lats.
instructions: Hang from a bar with an overhand grip well wider than your shoulders.
Pull your shoulder blades down, then pull your chest toward the bar.
Go up until your chin clears the bar.
Lower slowly to a full hang.

name: Wrist Extension
description: A wrist curl with the palms facing down that works the forearm extensors.
instructions: Sit with your forearms on your thighs or a bench, wrists hanging over the edge, palms facing down.
Hold a barbell with an overhand grip.
Raise the bar by extending your wrists, then lower slowly.

name: Wrist Roller
description: Rolling a weight up and down on a rope with a handle, which strongly works the forearms and grip.
instructions: Hold the wrist roller with both hands, arms extended in front of you at shoulder height.
Roll the handle with your wrists to wind the rope and lift the weight.
Once the weight reaches the top, unroll it slowly under control.

name: Yoga
description: A practice of postures, breathing and relaxation that improves flexibility, balance and recovery.
instructions: Start with a few minutes of calm breathing.
Move through the postures slowly, holding each one while breathing steadily.
Respect your range of motion and never force a position.
Finish with a few minutes of relaxation lying down.

name: Zercher Squat
description: A squat with the barbell held in the crook of the elbows, which strongly works the quads, upper back and core.
instructions: Set the bar at mid-torso height in a rack and hold it in the crook of your elbows, hands together.
Unrack the bar and stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down, keeping your chest up and the bar close to your body.
Drive back up through your whole foot.
